verdict.rationale: Make documents its own AI Agents app for agentic automation inside scenarios, and API endpoints to create and run AI Agents (open beta), so AI agent steps in workflows are a first-party capability. The evidence never shows model selection or tool use configured within those agent steps. The MCP server, which exposes scenarios as tools to external AI clients, is a different role and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented model/provider choice, documented tool use within agent steps, detail on LLM modules in scenarios, independent or hands-on corroboration, and a non-beta status.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can add AI agent or LLM steps inside a workflow, with model choice and tool use

citations.quote: learn about agentic automation with the make ai agents app
